text:
Sam B: CI went red on my PR (#4219) — only integration-3 failed, looks like a timeout in e2e. Can someone kick just that shard without rebuilding the image?

CI-bot: job failed: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/12345 (integration-3) — step: run-e2e (timeout)

Alex: Yep, that one is flaky. We can retrigger the shard-only run and skip the image rebuild. Use our ci helper.

Alex: ```
# from repo root
./scripts/ci retry --build 12345 --shard integration-3 --skip-image-build
```

Sam B: thanks — do I need any special perms for that or will it queue under my user?

Maria: If you run the script it uses your user token. If your token lacks permission, ping a colleague with CI rights. Note: GH rerun API doesn't support skip-image-build, that's only via our tool.

oncall-bot: Heads up: skipping image build is allowed for PRs < 24h or when the base image digest hasn't changed. If the base image changed, the run will fallback to full rebuild.

Sam B: PR is ~2 hours old, so should be fine. @Alex can you run it if you have a minute?

Alex: Kicked it: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/12346 — queued with --skip-image-build :crossed_fingers:

CI-bot: retriggered build 12346 (integration-3) — preserving image cache

Sam B: Appreciate it. If it flakes again I'll open a bisect task.

Maria: Quick bisect hint if it recurs:
```
# run from checkout
./scripts/ci bisect --range HEAD~8..HEAD --target integration-3
```
That will try narrowing to the first bad commit for that shard.

Sam B: Good to know — will ping here if it still fails. Thanks all!
